Guide.title: User Guide
Guide.description: Overview of ユートピオスフィア features

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: A sticky header at the top links to each feature. Click the bird logo to return home.

theme.title: Light / Dark Mode
theme.description: Click the sun / moon icon in the top-right header to toggle between light and dark themes.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch between Vietnamese and English via the language dropdown in the header.

search.title: Search
search.description: Click the magnifying glass icon to open the search dialog. Type keywords to find blog posts.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Browse personal projects. Click any project to view its description, tech stack, and links.

music.title: Music
music.description: A personal music playlist. Hit play to start listening. The floating music widget (bottom corner) lets you control playback from any page without navigating away.

discipline.title: Self-Discipline
discipline.description: A personal finance tracker with 3 tabs:

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Create and manage configuration "keys". Each key stores a list of income declarations (name, type, amount), plus options for locking expenses, rounding numbers, and setting a payment deadline. A key is required to access data.

transactions.name: Transactions
transactions.description: Log income and expense transactions by date. Browse transaction history by month.

statistics.name: Statistics
statistics.description: View charts and summaries of income and expenses over time, calculated from your declared income configuration.

chinese.title: 漢字 Chinese Characters
chinese.description: A flashcard tool for learning Chinese characters. Filter by HSK levels 1–6. Two view modes:

modes.all: All cards: display all flashcards in order.
modes.byRadical: By radical: group characters by their radical for systematic study.

features.hide: Click a card to hide characters you already know.
features.knownFilter: Toggle "Show known only" to review learned characters.
features.edit: The site owner can edit card content by entering an authentication key.
